cover.prompt: On the paved terrace of the coastal library, scholar stands in 3/4 posture holding an open papyrus roll wide with both elbows 25 degrees outward, comparing recorded decree versions; librarian stands beside a stone abacus table, fingers active above rows of dark and white counting pebbles with hands held clear of her waist; a carved balustrade post anchors the right margin of the frame; the classical limestone colonnade recedes diagonally into the scene, framed against the tranquil expanse of Paxos bay with crystal-clear edges, vivid local materials, and no haze or bloom.
cover.others: a second librarian returning a scroll case to an exterior wall niche.
